# IT Infrastructure Optimization and Monitoring Plan

This document details the planned activities for optimizing and monitoring key IT infrastructure components.

## Key Initiatives:

*   Update API latency based on recent audit findings.
*   Optimize firewall settings through a standard update process.
*   Urgently optimize the database migration process.
*   Monitor API latency on a quarterly basis.
*   Monitor encryption standards on a quarterly basis.
